title: Libya's east seeks UN probe into claims Ukrainian military present in west

contentText: Authorities in divided Libya's east called on Monday for the United Nations to investigate claims that Ukrainian forces were present in the country's west, as they lodged a complaint over Ukrainian attacks on two Russian ships off Benghazi. The strikes on Sunday, claimed by Kyiv, come as Ukraine steps up strikes against Russia far from the front lines of their war. FRANCE 24's Emerald Maxwell reports.
